anomalies.symptom_observed: Terra classified the supported paraphrase 'that fear can calculate or bargain with' as QUESTIONABLE.
anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Visible reservation requires the verb 'bargain' in supplied evidence. Human review treats the clause as a stylistic restatement of IDEA224 'no set time'.
undemonstrated_causes: Unobservable internal Terra scoring of lexical overlap.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Local code can require a reason code on QUESTIONABLE. It cannot prove that Terra will accept the paraphrase.

anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Contract 1.1 allowed optional reservation notes without codes.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Local validation can FAIL missing codes. It cannot invent the correct code.

anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Model omitted terminators; 1.1.1 later allowed them.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Admissible-separator policy can ignore periods. Local offsets would not leave them to the model.

anomalies.note: Not a failure of detection; included as a true positive.
anomalies.symptom_observed: Because-clause isolated and blocked as UNSUPPORTED.
anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Effectiveness and resistance-by-truth are absent from evidence.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Semantic detection remains a model task.

anomalies.symptom_observed: 'an abuse to your very person' QUESTIONABLE.
anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Visible note treats intensifier 'very' as strengthening.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Presegmentation can isolate the phrase. It cannot decide stylistic freedom.

anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Terra treated truncated 'since.' as an incomplete reference.
undemonstrated_causes: Whether Terra mapped 'beginning' onto a biblical creation sense.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Catalog membership of the code is locally checkable; meaning is not.

anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Codes are absent from the closed catalog.
undemonstrated_causes: Why Terra invented near-synonyms instead of catalog codes.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Local code already FAILs unknown codes and must not silently normalize them. It cannot force Terra to emit catalog codes.

undemonstrated_causes: Whether origin-framing is a new implication or editorial staging.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Deterministic rules cannot resolve a close implication.

anomalies.symptom_observed: Three historically supported prefix clauses rejected.
anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Visible notes treat mental-technique, positive-thinking, and sermon illustration as new facts or invented examples.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Isolating prefix units reduces mixing with the guarantee. It does not prove Terra will accept the prefixes.

anomalies.demonstrated_cause: Terra spans are valid half-open intervals that end two characters short of the words they cover. These are not separators.
undemonstrated_causes: Why offsets repeatedly stopped two characters early.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Local presegmentation can own offsets. It cannot reconstruct omitted letters into Terra's historical JSON, which must stay unmodified.

anomalies.symptom_observed: Guarantee blocked with NEW_CONCLUSION, not NEW_IMPLICATION.
anomalies.demonstrated_cause: NEW_CONCLUSION is in the closed catalog.
undemonstrated_causes: Why the primary pair was not chosen.
anomalies.deterministic_correction_limits: Neighbor codes cannot be rewritten by local policy without changing the catalog.
